steps: Identify the mass of the block: m = W / g = 100 / 10 = 10 kg.
Write the equation of motion for the first case: F - μW = m * a_1, which gives F - 100μ = 10(1) = 10.
Write the equation of motion for the second case: 2F - μW = m * a_2, which gives 2F - 100μ = 10(10) = 100.
Multiply the first equation by 2 to get 2F - 200μ = 20.
Subtract this from the second equation: (2F - 100μ) - (2F - 200μ) = 100 - 20, yielding 100μ = 80.
Solve for the coefficient of friction: μ = 80 / 100 = 0.8.
